description: Opens the interactive Chop it app for an explicit request such as 'open Chop it', 'load the app' or 'show my This Week screen'. view selects this_week, saved_weeks, recipes, pantry, shopping or meal_planning; recipeId opens one recipe's own screen, which is how a person looks at a recipe from a plan, a search or their week. Returns the new app shell where enabled, otherwise a normal browser link. Reads and writes no account data and creates no draft. Available without an account; private screens require sign-in. In Work, use view shopping with shoppingQuestion to ask inline without opening or preparing a list. Skip questions already answered. For an explicit list review, open its exact review. First obtain the list’s handoffUrl with shop_week or open_shop_handoff, then pass shoppingReviewToken with view shopping, shoppingCountry and shoppingLanguage. A general Shop screen has no regional store chooser.

recipeId.description: Opens this one recipe's screen. A recipeId from a plan, a search, the week or the library; view is then recipes.

selectedLineIds.description: Exact current subset when the shopper selected specific lines.

shoppingCountry.description: Shopping or delivery country explicitly requested for this review (two-letter country code).

shoppingLanguage.description: The shopper's conversation language as a BCP 47 tag, independent of the delivery country.

shoppingQuestion.description: Inline Work dropdown. Use supermarket to discover a local store, choice for a single unresolved shopping question with a few verified options in the conversation language, or checks with the shoppingListId (and the selected lineIds) for the quick check before a shop: Chop it fills in the choices.

shoppingRetailerOrigin.description: Previously chosen public supermarket origin for this exact list review.

shoppingReviewToken.description: Use the exact final path segment of the current Chop it shopping review link. Opens the existing review in this chat.
